name: Gwen - Frederika Bernkastel
creator: yogau
description:
## Skin information
- **Champion:** Gwen
- **Modified skin:** Base (default)
- **Character:** Frederika Bernkastel (Umineko no Naku Koro ni)

## Features
- New model and texture (Bernkastel), scythe replacing the scissors
- Black cat replacing the needles on R and the doll in the joke emote
- Violet "sea of fragments" W, scissor trails removed, purple VFX
- New voice-over: meows on R, "Nipah~" on kills and blocked attacks, new laugh
- Custom music on the dance emote
- Modified loading screen, in-game icons and skill icons

## Installation
Install the .fantome with LTK Manager.

## Known issues
- Weighting isn't perfect: sleeves and skirt can clip in some animations.

## Credits
- 3D models generated with Meshy AI, then rigged and converted for League.
- Bernkastel and Umineko © 07th Expansion. Fan-made, not affiliated with Riot Games.
